# eCards

> eCards sells digital gift cards (Netflix, PlayStation, Xbox, Steam, Apple, Google Play, Spotify, PUBG Mobile, Razer Gold, Call of Duty) to customers in Ethiopia. Prices are in Birr with 15% VAT included, payment is by M-Pesa, and codes are delivered by SMS or email.

Each gift card page lists every card value with its price in Birr, the VAT amount and whether it is in stock. Markdown versions of the pages are linked below; the catalog JSON has the same data in one file.

## Key facts

- Prices are in Ethiopian Birr (ETB) and include 15% VAT. 1 US dollar of card value = Br 265.
- Payment: M-Pesa only. The customer approves the payment on their phone with their PIN.
- Delivery: the code shows on screen and in My orders, and is sent by SMS or email, usually within seconds. Out-of-stock cards can be pre-ordered.
- All sales are final: gift card codes can’t be refunded once delivered.
- The store is available in English, Amharic, Afaan Oromo, Somali and Tigrinya, and inside the M-Pesa app.

# Netflix gift card

> Buy a Netflix gift card in Ethiopia from Br 13,250.00 ($50–$200). Pay with M-Pesa, VAT included, code delivered by SMS or email in seconds.

URL: https://ecards.example.com/netflix-gift-card/
Prices updated 2026-10-19. 1 US dollar = Br 265.

## Netflix gift card prices in Birr

| Card value | Price (Birr) | VAT included | Availability |
|---|---|---|---|
| [$50](https://ecards.example.com/netflix-gift-card/50-usd/) | Br 13,250.00 | Br 1,728.26 | In stock |
| [$100](https://ecards.example.com/netflix-gift-card/100-usd/) | Br 26,500.00 | Br 3,456.52 | Pre-order (Expected by 2026-10-20) |
| [$150](https://ecards.example.com/netflix-gift-card/150-usd/) | Br 39,750.00 | Br 5,184.78 | In stock |
| [$200](https://ecards.example.com/netflix-gift-card/200-usd/) | Br 53,000.00 | Br 6,913.04 | In stock |

## How to use your Netflix code

1. Open Netflix on your phone, console or computer and sign in to your account.
2. Go to the place for gift cards or codes (often called Redeem, Add funds or Gift card).
3. Type in the code exactly as shown. The value is added to your balance straight away.

## Netflix gift card questions

### How much is a Netflix gift card in Ethiopia?

A Netflix gift card costs $50: Br 13,250.00, $100: Br 26,500.00, $150: Br 39,750.00, $200: Br 53,000.00, including 15% VAT.

### How do I get my Netflix code?

Pay with M-Pesa and the code appears on screen and in My orders straight away. We also send it by SMS or email. Cards that are out of stock are sent as soon as they arrive.

### Can I send a Netflix gift card to someone else?

Yes. At checkout choose SMS or email and enter their phone number or email address. They receive the code directly.

### Can I get a refund on a Netflix code?

No. Digital codes can’t be returned or refunded once delivered. If a code doesn’t work, contact eCards support and we will help.

# Help

URL: https://ecards.example.com/help/

## Questions and answers

### How fast do I get my code?

Cards in stock are delivered seconds after you approve the M-Pesa payment. The code shows on screen, in My orders, and by SMS or email.

### How do I pay?

With M-Pesa. Enter your M-Pesa number at checkout and approve the payment prompt on your phone with your PIN. We never ask for your PIN on this website.

### What is a pre-order?

When a card is out of stock you can still buy it. You pay now and we send the code automatically when the card arrives. The expected date is shown before you pay.

### Can I send a gift card to someone else?

Yes. At checkout choose SMS or email and enter their phone number or email address. They receive the code directly.

### Can I get a refund?

No. Gift card codes are digital and can’t be returned or refunded once delivered. If a code doesn’t work, contact us and we will help.

### Do I need an account?

You sign in with your phone number and a one-time SMS code. That keeps your orders and codes in one place.

## Terms of service

eCards sells digital gift card codes for use with the brands shown. Prices are in Ethiopian Birr and include 15% VAT. An order is confirmed when M-Pesa confirms your payment.

Codes are for personal use and may not be resold. Each brand’s own terms apply when you redeem a code.

## No-refund policy

All sales are final. Gift card codes can’t be returned, exchanged or refunded once delivered, because a delivered code can be used straight away.

If a code doesn’t work, or a pre-order is late, contact us with your order number and we will make it right.

## Privacy policy

We keep your name, phone number, the email or number you send codes to, and your orders. We use them to deliver your codes and help you. We don’t sell your data.

Payments are handled by M-Pesa; we never see or store your M-Pesa PIN.

## Contact us

- Email: support@example.com
- Every day, 08:00–22:00
